Data envelope for creating a ChatGPT Enterprise integration account.

attributes [required]

object

Writable attributes used to create a ChatGPT Enterprise integration account.

authentication [required]

 <oneOf>

Authentication for creating the ChatGPT Enterprise integration account. Exactly one method is set.

<auth_type=bearer_token>

object

Bearer token authentication. Use an admin key created in the OpenAI Admin Console of your ChatGPT Enterprise workspace, not in the API Platform admin-key console, with the Costs permission set to Read.

auth_type [required]

enum

The authentication method type. Allowed enum values: bearer_token

default: bearer_token

token [required]

string

Secret token used to authenticate with ChatGPT Enterprise.

dataflows

object

Data Datadog collects from ChatGPT Enterprise, keyed by dataflow id. Each dataflow turns on a distinct kind of collection: set enabled to start or stop it. Defaults listed on each dataflow apply when the account is created; on update, omitted fields keep their current values. Every dataflow requires a ChatGPT Enterprise workspace with access to the OpenAI Costs API; a dataflow enabled without it is stored but collects no data.

chatgpt-enterprise-agent-console

object

Activity, token consumption, credits, and estimated usage costs across ChatGPT Chat, ChatGPT Work, and Codex, shown in Agent Console with breakdowns by product, model, and user where OpenAI provides them. Data already available from OpenAI appears within 1 hour of enabling this dataflow.

enabled [required]

boolean

Whether Datadog collects this data. Defaults to true; set to false to stop collection.

chatgpt-enterprise-cloud-cost-data

object

ChatGPT Enterprise costs from the OpenAI Costs API, so that ChatGPT Enterprise spend can be analyzed in Cloud Cost Management. These costs are excluded from Cloud Cost Management spend-monitored billing. Reported costs are estimates, not final invoice amounts.

enabled

boolean

Whether Datadog collects this data. Defaults to false; set to true to start collection.

name [required]

string

Human-readable name of the ChatGPT Enterprise integration account.

settings [required]

object

Settings for creating the ChatGPT Enterprise integration account.

openai_org_id [required]

string

OpenAI API Platform organization ID (org-...) that the Costs API uses for your Enterprise usage. This is not the ChatGPT workspace UUID or your Datadog organization ID. A value that does not match ^org-[A-Za-z0-9]+$ is rejected with a 422 response.

type [required]

enum

The type of the integration account resource. Always integration-account. Allowed enum values: integration-account

default: integration-account

data [required]

object

Data envelope for updating a ChatGPT Enterprise integration account.

attributes [required]

object

Writable attributes used to update a ChatGPT Enterprise integration account. Every field is optional; only the fields provided are changed. When dataflows is provided, only the dataflow ids included in the request are modified; dataflows omitted from the map keep their current configuration.

authentication

 <oneOf>

Authentication for updating the ChatGPT Enterprise integration account. Exactly one method is set.

<auth_type=bearer_token>

object

Bearer token authentication. Use an admin key created in the OpenAI Admin Console of your ChatGPT Enterprise workspace, not in the API Platform admin-key console, with the Costs permission set to Read. Only the fields provided are changed; omit token to keep the stored one.

auth_type [required]

enum

The authentication method type. Allowed enum values: bearer_token

default: bearer_token

token

string

Secret token used to authenticate with ChatGPT Enterprise.

dataflows

object

Data Datadog collects from ChatGPT Enterprise, keyed by dataflow id. Each dataflow turns on a distinct kind of collection: set enabled to start or stop it. Defaults listed on each dataflow apply when the account is created; on update, omitted fields keep their current values. Every dataflow requires a ChatGPT Enterprise workspace with access to the OpenAI Costs API; a dataflow enabled without it is stored but collects no data.

chatgpt-enterprise-agent-console

object

Activity, token consumption, credits, and estimated usage costs across ChatGPT Chat, ChatGPT Work, and Codex, shown in Agent Console with breakdowns by product, model, and user where OpenAI provides them. Data already available from OpenAI appears within 1 hour of enabling this dataflow.

enabled [required]

boolean

Whether Datadog collects this data. Defaults to true; set to false to stop collection.

chatgpt-enterprise-cloud-cost-data

object

ChatGPT Enterprise costs from the OpenAI Costs API, so that ChatGPT Enterprise spend can be analyzed in Cloud Cost Management. These costs are excluded from Cloud Cost Management spend-monitored billing. Reported costs are estimates, not final invoice amounts.

enabled

boolean

Whether Datadog collects this data. Defaults to false; set to true to start collection.

name

string

Human-readable name of the ChatGPT Enterprise integration account.

settings

object

Settings for updating the ChatGPT Enterprise integration account. Only the fields provided are changed.

openai_org_id

string

OpenAI API Platform organization ID (org-...) that the Costs API uses for your Enterprise usage. This is not the ChatGPT workspace UUID or your Datadog organization ID. A value that does not match ^org-[A-Za-z0-9]+$ is rejected with a 422 response.

id [required]

string

Unique identifier of the ChatGPT Enterprise integration account to update.

type [required]

enum

The type of the integration account resource. Always integration-account. Allowed enum values: integration-account

default: integration-account
